units.title: Verify: Phaser render context unit tests

tests.id: places image at the spec position with the resolved key, scale and depth
tests.name: createPhaserRenderContext.createSprite > places image at the spec position with the resolved key, scale and depth
tests.title: places image at the spec position with the resolved key, scale and depth
tests.scenario: Given a fake scene and a spec at (5,6) with scale 2, depth 3 and bounds 0,0,10,20, When createSprite runs, Then the image is added at (5,6) with the resolved key, scaled, given depth, and made interactive with a Rectangle of the bounds

tests.name: createPhaserRenderContext handle > setHighlighted(true) tints the image and setHighlighted(false) clears the tint
tests.title: setHighlighted(true) tints the image and setHighlighted(false) clears the tint
tests.scenario: Given a created sprite, When setHighlighted is called true then false, Then setTint(0xffff66) then clearTint are called

tests.name: createPhaserRenderContext handle > setLabelVisible(true) shows the label text
tests.title: setLabelVisible(true) shows the label text
tests.scenario: Given a created sprite, When setLabelVisible(true), Then label.setVisible(true) is called

tests.name: createPhaserRenderContext handle > setVisible(false) hides the image (adapted: the label is not hidden by this call)
tests.title: setVisible(false) hides the image (adapted: the label is not hidden by this call)
tests.scenario: Given a created sprite, When setVisible(false), Then image.setVisible(false) is called
tests.detail: Step 2 expected the label to hide; the code hides the image. Test follows the code. See note.

tests.name: createPhaserRenderContext handle > onHover receives true on pointerover and false on pointerout
tests.title: onHover receives true on pointerover and false on pointerout
tests.scenario: Given a hover callback, When pointerover then pointerout fire on the image, Then the callback receives true then false

tests.name: createPhaserRenderContext handle > onClick runs the callback on pointerdown
tests.title: onClick runs the callback on pointerdown
tests.scenario: Given a click callback, When pointerdown fires on the image, Then the callback runs once

tests.name: createPhaserRenderContext handle > destroy destroys both the image and the label
tests.title: destroy destroys both the image and the label
tests.scenario: Given a created sprite, When destroy is called, Then image.destroy and label.destroy are each called once

units.title: Verify: BootScene builds objects from content with none hardcoded

tests.id: bootSceneBuild.test.ts::BootScene build wiring::calls buildScene once with the render context and bundled scene spec
tests.name: build wiring: buildScene called once with (ctx, sceneSpec)
tests.title: BootScene builds scene objects once from the bundled scene spec when create() runs
tests.scenario: Given a BootScene with mocked buildScene and render context, When create() runs, Then buildScene is called once with the render context and sceneSpec
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/bootSceneBuild.test.ts -t 'build wiring' --testTimeout=20000

tests.id: bootSceneBuild.test.ts::BootScene build wiring::destroys every built object on SHUTDOWN
tests.name: build wiring: SHUTDOWN destroys each scene object once
tests.title: BootScene destroys every built scene object once when the scene shuts down
tests.scenario: Given create() registered a SHUTDOWN listener, When the captured listener is invoked, Then each fake object's destroy is called once
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/bootSceneBuild.test.ts -t 'build wiring' --testTimeout=20000

tests.id: bootSceneBuild.test.ts::BootScene source has no hardcoded scene content::no quoted object or asset id in BootScene.ts or renderContext.ts
tests.name: no hardcoded: no quoted scene object/asset ids in source
tests.title: BootScene and renderContext source contain no hardcoded object or asset ids from the bundled scene
tests.scenario: Given sceneSpec.objects ids and assets, When BootScene.ts and renderContext.ts source text is scanned, Then no quoted id ('id', "id", `id`) appears
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/bootSceneBuild.test.ts -t 'no hardcoded' --testTimeout=20000

units.title: Verify: BootScene state sync and objectClick forwarding

tests.id: bootSceneSync.test.ts::syncs scene objects with the store state on create and on each state change, and ignores a null state
tests.name: sync and null state
tests.title: BootScene syncs scene objects with the store state on create and on each state change, and ignores a null state
tests.scenario: Given the store holds an initial state, When create() runs and then the store changes to a second state, Then sync is called with the initial and then the second state; When the store is set to null, Then sync is not called again
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/bootSceneSync.test.ts -t 'sync' --testTimeout=10000
tests.detail: Passed. The -t 'sync' filter also matched the second test, because the describe title contains 'sync', so both tests ran and passed.

tests.id: bootSceneSync.test.ts::forwards an object interaction to React as objectClick with the object id
tests.name: objectClick forwarding
tests.title: BootScene forwards an object interaction to React as objectClick with the object id
tests.scenario: Given create() has wired the scene objects, When an object's interact callback fires with objectId 'abc', Then phaserToReact emits objectClick with { id: 'abc' }
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/bootSceneSync.test.ts --testTimeout=10000
